item.title: Crash turns deadly on SR-132 in Juab County
item.description: A crash on SR-132 in Juab County turned fatal on Thursday morning after a semitruck and car crashed.

item.title: 1 in serious condition after car caught fire in Murray
item.description: One person was taken to the hospital in serious condition after the vehicle they were in caught fire on I-215 Thursday.

item.title: US job openings fall to 6.5 million, fewest since 2020, as labor market remains sluggish
item.description: U.S. job openings fell to the lowest level in more than five years, another sign that the American labor market remains sluggish.

item.title: Utah 211 asking for funding to expand its services to Utah’s at-risk population
item.description: Utah 211 is asking for $200,000 to expand its services and provide follow-up support.

item.title: Residents react after earthquake reported near Saratoga Springs
item.description: An earthquake measuring 3.4 in magnitude hit 3.7 miles north and northwest of Saratoga Springs.

item.title: Salt Lake County Jail’s capacity problems span two decades, audit finds
item.description: A new legislative audit found Salt Lake County Jail has been dealing with a capacity problem for years and auditors say county leaders need to act quickly before the problem gets worse.

item.title: Ogden celebrates 175 years with festivities
item.description: The city of Ogden is celebrating its 175th birthday Friday at Union Station with food trucks, live music, free museum entry and original historical documents never before displayed to the public.

item.title: Homeland Security shutdown grows more likely as Republicans rebuff Democrats’ ICE demands
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune says Democrats' demands for new restrictions on federal immigration officers are “unrealistic” as they threaten a shutdown if their demands are not met.

item.title: BYU athletic director confident Big 12 schools serious about stopping fan chants targeting Mormons
item.description: A BYU sports team was the target of a derogatory chant in an opponent’s venue for at least the fourth time in a year, and the Big 12 again announced the conference would look into the matter and the home team offered an apology.

item.title: Utah trees, the winter damage that can impact them, and how to combat it
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY — Winter can be a difficult time for the entire landscape, and trees and shrubs are no exception. Frozen ground, drought stress, rapid temperature swings, and wildlife damage can all take a toll during the winter months.
